items.author: Ben (2026-09-11, "we should shrink the industry tree"); Claude (found the cause while building the Exploration tree)
items.title: Industry's ring 1 is the exploration age: migrate it out and shift every ring down
items.design:
BEN, 2026-09-11: "we should shrink the industry tree" (resolving NR-844, which reported it oversized after the span fell 400 -> 300 years).

THE NAIVE SHRINK IS WRONG AND MUST NOT BE DONE. Dropping the outer ring is the obvious cut and it removes RING 4: Electrification, Internal Combustion & Oil, Flight, Automotive Transport, Broadcast, Antibiotics & Mass Vaccination, Synthetic Chemistry, Fixed-Nitrogen Synthesis, Tractor & Fertiliser. That is the twentieth century, and the campaign epoch is 1960. Ring 4 stays.

THE REAL FINDING: RING 1 IS THE EXPLORATION AGE. Measured 2026-09-11 while authoring EXPLORATION_TREE.md. Ring 1 holds Full-Rigged Ship, Celestial Navigation, Chronometer, Joint-Stock & Public Credit, Chartered Capital, Movable-Type Press, Crop-Package Exchange. Those are 1200-1660 subjects, and they sat in the Industry tree only because no Exploration tree existed to hold them. TWO ARE OUTRIGHT DUPLICATES of nodes now authored: IN-MV-1b Full-Rigged Ship and IN-MV-1c Celestial Navigation against EX-HL-2a Ocean Carrack and EX-HL-3a Oceanic Navigation; IN-CH-1b/IN-CH-1d against EX-SP-2a The Chartered Company.

THE WORK. Ring 1 (18 nodes) migrates out: some subjects are already covered by the Exploration tree and are simply dropped, others may earn a place in it. Rings 2/3/4 shift down to 1/2/3. Industry becomes 3 rings, 5 branches, 3 milestones, ~44 nodes -- which is also the proportional target (62 x 300/400 = 46), reached by MEANING rather than by arithmetic, which is why it is believable.

EVERY NODE ID CHANGES, because an id carries its ring. That is the bulk of the work and it is mechanical: renumber, rewrite links/requires/excludes, rewrite the doc's tables, re-run tree_lint.js industry. THE RIM MILESTONE'S MEANING IS UNCHANGED -- it still opens nothing and ends the chain; only its id moves.

WATCH FOR: rule 4 breakage. Each milestone requires majors at ITS OWN ring from two branches; after a shift the old ring-2 milestone's requires are still ring-2 ids that are now ring 1, so they travel together, but any milestone whose requires named a ring-1 major that got DROPPED needs a new requirement. The lint catches this; do not hand-wave it.

DONE WHEN: tree_lint.js passes on both industry and exploration, no subject appears in both trees, ring 4's contents survive as ring 3, and TREES.md's size row states the new shape.

items.author: Ben (2026-09-11, Exploration design session); Claude (written into EXPLORATION.md)
items.title: Draw a fleet or a caravan when a corridor's throughput crosses a threshold
items.design:
BEN, 2026-09-11: "We also want to visualise fleets and caravans moving, this can be heavily abstracted since the pace of our time-lapse is too fast, so we will just render examples when a threshold supply is reached."

AN EXEMPLAR STANDS FOR THE FLOW; IT DOES NOT DEPICT IT. One sail, one caravan, drawn on a corridor whose throughput crosses a threshold. Not one mark per cargo, not an animation of traffic -- the time-lapse runs centuries per second and a faithful depiction would be noise.

THIS COSTS A COMPARISON, AND ONLY BECAUSE BL-940 EXISTS. The flow is already one number per corridor, so the visual is a FILTER ON THAT NUMBER rather than a second simulation. If this item is reached before BL-940, it has nothing to read -- that dependency is the whole reason the corridor number was kept when per-good routing was cut.

WHERE IT DRAWS. The Exploration span's round in the wizard, beside the existing era time-lapse surface (BL-916's typed event layer, BL-919's lineage palette, BL-915's terrain underlay). Sea exemplars on water corridors, land exemplars on road corridors, and the ROAD RUNG should be legible in the mark -- a Highway corridor and a Track corridor must not draw the same.

ALSO DRAW THE CONSOLIDATION (BL-932). The one-time flow of seat stores into the capital at 1200 is the phase's opening act and Ben called it out as something the lapse can show.

A VISUAL REQUIREMENT NEEDS A LIVE CLICK, not only a capture (standing rules). Arrive on the Exploration round in the built app and watch it.

items.author: Ben (2026-09-11, Exploration design session); Claude (written into EXPLORATION.md)
items.title: Faith fractures an empire — the schism verb, and the reassertion that never fires
items.design:
BEN, 2026-09-11: "faith is another strong lever for conflict in this phase - we could even model a schism." THE REFERENCE IS A MECHANISM AND THE NAME IS NEVER CONTENT (standing rule): the creed is generated and named by the phoneme banks like every other.

THE SUBSTRATE IS BUILT AND WAS LEFT DELIBERATELY OPEN. The universalising creed landed 2026-09-11: a `universal_creed` record belonging to nobody, `polity::universal_creed` as the INSTITUTION, `region::creed_hold` (none / dual-hold / converted / reasserted) as the PEOPLE, and `region::creed_residue_culture` recorded at contact and kept whichever way the pair resolves -- which is precisely the line a schism cuts along. CREEDS.md sec The four calls, settled owns it. The schism VERB was named as a later slice; this is that slice.

=== READ THIS BEFORE BUILDING: REASSERTION FIRED ZERO TIMES IN 16 WORLDS. ===
Measured on delivery. The branch is live and correct but unexercised: held ground under an adopting realm sits well above the binding floor, because BL-896's secession floor has ALREADY removed the badly-reached ground. So the TURMOIL half of the creed design currently does nothing, and A SCHISM BUILT ON TOP OF IT WOULD ALSO FIRE ZERO TIMES. `universal_creed_convert_supply_q` and `universal_creed_alien_penalty_q` are the dials; the honest reading recorded on delivery is that it needs a higher floor or a SECOND BINDING TERM. THAT IS BEN'S CALL AND IT GATES THIS ITEM -- fix the substrate first, or this builds a verb nothing reaches.

WHY THE PHASE WANTS IT. CREEDS.md already argues a universalising creed gives a motive to expand toward PEOPLE rather than toward GROUND, and gives a SECOND, INDEPENDENT WAY TO FALL -- one that has nothing to do with distance. Exploration needs exactly that: a source of conflict that is not the arms race and not a want, and one a NON-COLONISING realm can be torn apart by (BL-942).

THE FAULT LINE IS ALREADY NAMED: the gap between a polity's adopted institution and its peoples' uneven conversion. An empire whose institution is universal and whose subject peoples are not is exactly the empire that splits over faith rather than over distance.

DONE WHEN: reassertion fires in some worlds and not others as a consequence of upstream scalars; a schism fractures at least one realm in a sweep along the residue line; and the fracture is distinguishable in the readings from a network-failure collapse.

items.author: Ben (2026-09-11, Exploration design session); Claude (written into EXPLORATION.md)
items.title: Spend is estimated once at 1960 and seeds the campaign's depletion reserve
items.design:
SETTLED (Ben, 2026-09-11): "For depletion accounting, I would prefer if we retrofit this, and come to a sensible estimate at the very end of digitisation. For generation you are right in that keeping items abstract is best policy." So NO ACCUMULATOR IS ADDED anywhere in the history sim, and sprint 39's closed Empire span is NOT reopened.

WHY IT MATTERS. Ben, 2026-09-11, on what digitisation passes forward: "the main levers we pass are going to be about how much of easily accessible resource has been actually spent." The saturated corporate web forms around what is LEFT.

WHERE IT LANDS IS ALREADY BUILT, AND THIS IS THE ELEGANT PART. `tile_component::resource_remaining` (components.hpp) is a finite reserve, live, drawn down by extraction and tapering output as it empties -- and it is SEEDED AT GENERATION to richness x a reserve factor (tile_generation.cpp). The two economy phases set that seed instead of a constant. Ground worked for centuries hands the campaign a thinner reserve. No new field, no new accumulator, no change to the campaign's extraction loop.

THE PRICE OF RETROFITTING, STATED PLAINLY AND ACCEPTED. An estimate computed once at 1960 can NEVER BE CHECKED against what actually happened, because nothing recorded it. That makes it a STATED FORMULA rather than a measurement. THE FORMULA MUST THEREFORE BE WRITTEN DOWN AS ONE -- named inputs, named arithmetic, in DIGITISATION.md -- or it silently becomes a fudge factor nobody can audit. Writing it down IS the work; an unwritten estimate is the failure mode.

ITS INPUTS ARE THE ABSTRACT ONES THE SIM ALREADY HOLDS: how long ground was held and worked, its `dominant` region class, whether it industrialised and when, and the corridor throughput that ran off it (BL-940).

PARKED UNTIL DIGITISATION IS DESIGNED. DIGITISATION.md is a placeholder by Ben's ruling; this item is filed now so the decision is not lost, and it is NOT sprint 40 work.
